_comment: The PICTURE each errand's card is drawn as (#2340) — one prompt per errand, and the
prompt is what is kept rather than the picture: this repository holds text, so the
art lives in results/errand_art/ (git-ignored) and any machine re-draws its own with
THE GAME'S OWN SPRITE IS THE REFERENCE, never the picture itself: the sprite named in
errand_icons.json travels with the prompt so the model matches the client's colours
and materials, and the scene is composed for a card instead of an icon being blown up
The default model is the newest OpenAI picture model OpenRouter carries; a run says
what it cost, and one picture is roughly a quarter of a credit.
shared: Use the attached sprite ONLY as a style and colour reference — do not copy, crop or stretch it; compose a full scene of your own. Mobile-game 3D render look, clean rim light, painterly, high detail, crisp. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI frames, no watermark. Composition: the subject in the left two thirds, the right side calmer and darker so overlaid white text stays readable.
_references_comment: Which sprites travel WITH the prompt (#2340). Left unsaid, an errand sends its own
sprite off errand_icons.json — right when that sprite depicts the thing. Where it
does not (the truck errand's own icon is the idle-reward CLOCK), the sprites that do
are named here by stem, and the errand's own one is not sent at all: a clock in front
of a model asked for a truck is noise, not a reference.
_focus_comment: WHERE THE CROP LANDS (#2340). A cover is square and a card is a wide band, so the
browser shows a stripe of it — and which stripe is a fact about the PICTURE, not a
rule for all of them: the crates picture has its subject low, the truck has its loaded
bed high. One CSS vertical position per errand, read by the panel and handed to the
stylesheet; an errand not named here is cropped at the default (60%).

prompts.collect_base_resources: Draw a wide landscape banner illustration for a mobile game UI card meaning 'collect the resources the base has produced'. The scene: several blue-and-yellow armoured supply crates stacked at the edge of a futuristic survival base, glowing collection sparkles rising from them, resource icons (gold coins, food, steel bars) floating upward as they are gathered, warm evening light. It must read instantly as 'resources are being collected from the base'.
prompts.collect_truck_resources: Draw a wide landscape banner illustration for a mobile game UI card meaning 'collect what the armed supply truck has brought in'. The scene: a heavy armoured cargo truck — plated cab, bull bar, a mounted gun turret over the roof — standing at the gate of a futuristic survival base, seen from a three-quarter front angle. Its open cargo bed is FULL of resources and they are the point of the picture: blue-and-yellow armoured supply crates, stacked steel bars, sacks of grain and a spill of gold coins, catching the light. Warm evening light, faint dust in the air. It must read instantly as 'the armed truck came back loaded'.
